name: block-triage
description: Deploy Step 2 per prototype section: block or default content, Block Collection match, reuse of an existing block, decode tier and component-model shape (#126). Rank stage — re-check the shortlist with block-fit.

fields.section: one section of the section schema: { name, items: [{role, text, href}], repeats: [{count, uniform, unit}] }
fields.registry: the site's existing blocks: object of block name → one-line description (from the conversion log)

instructions.question: Should `section` become a block rather than default content?
instructions.focus: Default content is prose an author writes in place: headings, paragraphs, a single image, a single CTA. A block is a composition — repeated units, a layout with slots, a control, an embed.

criteria.true: Repeated units (cards, tiles, FAQ rows), a multi-slot composition (hero with eyebrow, headline, actions, media), a control, a player or an embed.
criteria.false: Headings and paragraphs in reading order with at most a single image or CTA.

instructions.question: Which Block Collection shape does `section` match?
instructions.focus: Match the authoring shape (what rows an author fills), not the visual style.

criteria.hero: One lead composition: headline, optional eyebrow and text, actions, a media element.
criteria.cards: Repeated units each with an image, a title, text and optionally a link.
criteria.columns: Side-by-side content of unequal kinds (text beside media, two text columns).
criteria.carousel: Repeated units shown one or a few at a time with navigation.
criteria.accordion: Question/answer or title/body pairs that expand and collapse.
criteria.tabs: Labelled panels, one visible at a time.
criteria.table: Tabular data with a header row.
criteria.video: A video player or poster with a play action.
criteria.embed: A third-party surface by URL (map, social post, form service).

appendNone.none: No Block Collection shape fits: a bespoke composition.

instructions.question: Which existing block in `registry` should render `section`, possibly with a variant class?
instructions.focus: Same authored rows and the same decorate shape means the same block; a different look on the same rows is a variant, still the same block.

appendNone.new-block: No existing block takes these rows: author a new block.

template_slotted.what: A fixed composition whose structure never changes at authoring time; the block moves the authored elements into fixed slots.

reconstructive.what: Repeating or data-driven units that authors add or remove; the block classifies and segments rows.

instructions.question: Which component-model shape describes how an author fills `section`?

criteria.simple: One property per row: a fixed set of rows, each a single value.
criteria.key_value: Configuration rows of name and value.
criteria.container: The block's own rows plus one row per child item.
